tbesh_html:
1) to cease, cause to cease, cut off, destroy, perish
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to cease
1a2) to cause to cease, destroy
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be cut off
1b2) to be undone, be cut off at sight of the theophany

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be dumb or silent; hence, to fail or perish; trans. to destroy
strongs_1890.kjv_def: cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, [idiom] utterly.
